limitations: Page/property and country/page aggregations are separate; no forced equality or cross-source conversion rate.
GSC country-by-page returned 97 Gulf clicks versus 178 in the country-only report. The gap is unresolved; do not use it for an exact country-language traffic share or population inference.
GA4 Gulf country/source report sums to 164 Google-organic sessions; added landing-page/browser-language dimensions sum to 165. Keep report scopes distinct and do not claim exact reconciliation.
Arabic page language, query language, browser language, country and nationality are not interchangeable. Country-level traffic includes English pages.
Query rows omit withheld queries and are not a complete search-demand census. Own-site impressions do not measure market keyword volume.
No current Arabic Google URL Inspection, local-country SERP rank test, market-volume estimate, entitlement/payment or cost audit was performed.
Observed week-on-week increase is descriptive on a small sample and does not prove causality or 10x attainability.

source_audit.finding: Core Arabic owners are live and indexable by response, not proven currently indexed by URL Inspection.
source_audit.boundary: HTTP 200, self-canonical, index/follow and historical GSC clicks do not replace current Google URL Inspection.

source_audit.finding: Arabic shape guidance uses compact repeated explanations rather than distinct per-shape/per-frame answers.
source_audit.boundary: Verified content deficit; not a demonstrated cause of low traffic.

source_audit.finding: The actual winning Arabic face-identification and photo-selection owners lack the specific visual/example sections supplied to English or Japanese.
source_audit.boundary: Preserve the winning Arabic URLs and titles until intent evidence supports a change; do not clone English owner allocation.

source_audit.finding: Free Detector result copy still contains hardcoded English and links into intentionally noindexed non-English education owners.
source_audit.boundary: Shared non-English experience gap, not an explanation established for search clicks; no blanket noindex removal.

external_primary_examples.observed: Arabic face-shape glasses selection and sizing answers exist; shows competing Arabic content, not market volume or rankings.

decision.proposal: Improve the two existing Arabic winning owners first with distinct short task answers, useful original RTL visuals and relevant Arabic topic links. No new duplicate routes or blanket translation batch.
decision.pilot_goal: Planning target: Arabic page-level Web clicks >=250 per comparable finalized 28 days from the 190 baseline, plus broader relevant nonbrand query coverage; not a forecast or causal threshold.
decision.review: After confirmed recrawl and two usable finalized windows. MODIFY if no net topic-click/query gain; STOP duplicate expansion or net displacement; INCONCLUSIVE if insufficient exposure. No purchase or completion gate.
decision.implementation_status: PROPOSED, not implemented or deployed by this diagnostic.
